scope: Background measurement-covariance audit only. No galaxy motion, gravity residual or source mass is fitted or scored.
trigger: The current estimator subtracts an arithmetic calibration-region mean per channel but treats that estimate as exact in held-region covariance. Its calibration sample variance is also reduced by mean estimation under spatial correlation.
source_dataset: The 12 local THINGS coarse cube packets bound by the parent noise results; only the existing guarded background annulus is consumed.

equations.mean_weights: w_i=1/n for the same calibration pixels as the previous estimator.
equations.alpha: w^T K_cc w, for the frozen estimated spatial correlation K.
equations.variance_correction: E[n^-1 sum_i (epsilon_i-mean(epsilon))^2] = C_jj (1-alpha), since K has unit diagonal. Third branch divides the previously estimated channel covariance by 1-alpha.
equations.interpretation: Exact marginal covariance of the declared linear mean subtraction when the covariance parameters are known; a plug-in diagnostic when estimated. This is not the full conditional Gaussian-process predictor or a marginalized hyperparameter likelihood.

unchanged: All 16 declared partitions and original guards
Original spatial Gaussian precision estimator and nugget
inference_limits: All real partitions were already opened in development; none is an untouched confirmation set.
The empirical spatial kernel and channel correlations remain estimates from the same calibration pixels. This correction does not integrate their uncertainty or remove spatial-fit bias.
A passing background diagnostic does not validate transfer to the galaxy, emission masking, Gaussianity, separability, or exact score significance.
No winning partition, covariance branch or galaxy is selected using gravity agreement.
